questions.question: Describe the shape of the Earth and what it is made of.
questions.expected_answer: The Earth is a sphere, shaped like a ball. It is made mostly of rock. The outside is a thin crust of rock and soil, and deep inside it is very hot.

questions.question: Name the three main parts of the Earth's surface and say which part covers most of it.
questions.expected_answer: The three main parts are land, water and air. Water covers most of the Earth's surface, about seven out of every ten parts, in oceans and seas.

questions.question: Explain the difference between a continent and an island, and give an example of each.
questions.expected_answer: A continent is one of the seven biggest pieces of land on Earth, for example Africa. An island is a smaller piece of land with water all around it, for example Robben Island or Madagascar.
